info.title: Kargoplex API
info.description: The Kargoplex public API: parties, quotes, jobs, document requests and invoices for your own company. Authenticate with an API key from Settings → Developers (`Authorization: Bearer kp_live_…`). Each key carries scopes, and each plan sets calls a minute per company and calls a month. Every response is `{ success, data }` or `{ success: false, error, code }`.

List your parties (customers, consignees, agents, carriers). Filter by q, role, status; paginate with page/limit.

Requires the `parties:read` scope and the plan's `apiRead` feature.
